name: Orchid Magenta
lede: Orchid Magenta is an xkcd survey name in the orchid flower family, filed by the ISCC-NBS system as a strong reddish purple.

sections.title: A flower word, not a modifier
sections.body:
Our graph files Orchid Magenta as a plant-family name in its own right, recorded by the 2010 xkcd crowd survey [1]. The ISCC-NBS block for it reads "strong reddish purple", and in Munsell terms it sits near 8.6P 4.4/13.8, quite saturated [1].

Its closest standing colors in our library are [[orchid|Orchid]], [[dark-orchid|Dark Orchid]] and [[medium-orchid|Medium Orchid]], all lighter or less red than this swatch [1]. The hex is a screen value; no dye is implied by the orchid connection [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body:
No painting in our 23,781-painting archive carries this exact swatch covering at least 1% of its canvas, as photographed [2]. That describes a gap in this particular archive, not a claim that reddish purples never appear in painting [2].

The word pairing itself has no strong signal in our Ngram data separate from its 2010 survey record, so we do not quote a peak decade for it here [2].
